page_title: ARS 2-2 CRY | Arsenal v Crystal Palace 23/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Michael Salisbury has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
90+6' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is adjudged offside.
90+5' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
90+3' A pass by Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
90+2' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) picks up the ball, weaves through three defenders and unleashes a nice powerful strike. His effort zooms past the left-hand post, though. That was a close one!
90+1' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
87' A player from Crystal Palace commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
86' Mikel Arteta has decided to make a change. Kieran Tierney (Arsenal) replaces Myles Lewis-Skelly.
86' It will be a substitution. Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) is ready to enter the pitch as Martin Odegaard walks off.
86' Thomas Partey (Arsenal) is penalised for holding. Michael Salisbury signals a set piece.

83' 2 - 2 Goal! Some very poor defending from the opponent allows Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) the chance to get to the edge of the box and he makes no mistake with a lovely finish. It's 2:2.
81' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) rises above the defence to meet a cross from the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches wide of the right post.
81' Declan Rice (Arsenal) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
80' Oliver Glasner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) replacing Eddie Nketiah.
80' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Justin Devenny as he is replaced by Romain Esse (Crystal Palace).

80' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the roof of the net, but Dean Henderson pulls off a brilliant save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Arsenal.
79' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
76' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) sends a chip pass into the box, but David Raya is quickest to intercept the ball.
75' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
73' The goal by Arsenal is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to the ball going out of play.
72' Goooooal for Arsenal! But referee Michael Salisbury straight away wants to review it with VAR, presumably to see if the ball went out of play in the build-up.
69' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) is flagged for offside.
68' Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
67' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the left post.
67' Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
67' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Crystal Palace will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
66' A corner kick by Crystal Palace is thwarted by the well prepared David Raya (Arsenal).

65' Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) meets an accurate cross inside the six-yard box and attempts a bullet header, but the goalkeeper denies him and makes the save. Corner kick. Crystal Palace will have an opportunity.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adam Wharton departs the field of play to be replaced by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace).
63' Here is a change. Eberechi Eze is going off and Oliver Glasner gives the last tactical orders to Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace).
62' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
60' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) whips in a cross from the corner, but Dean Henderson is well positioned and punches the ball away.
60' Here comes a substitution. Raheem Sterling is given a rest as he is replaced by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal).

59' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The referee points to the corner flag and Arsenal will take a corner.
58' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) serves up a nice cross, but David Raya punches the ball away.
57' Crystal Palace hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
55' Declan Rice (Arsenal) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Myles Lewis-Skelly, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
52' Leandro Trossard almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
49' Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
48' Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) picks up an injury.
48' William Saliba (Arsenal) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.

48' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
47' Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
47' A clumsy foul by Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle.
46' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' What was Declan Rice (Arsenal) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
45+1' A weak shot from the edge of the box by Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) is easily saved by Dean Henderson.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
44' Declan Rice (Arsenal) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
44' A cross into the box from Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) is cleared. Arsenal win a corner.
42' 2 - 1 Goal! Jurrien Timber tees up Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom right corner. 2:1.
40' The ball possession at the moment is 68:32.
37' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
34' Declan Rice (Arsenal) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
31' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.
31' Crystal Palace fail to score from a corner as David Raya (Arsenal) leaps to collect the ball.

30' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. Crystal Palace earn a corner.
29' Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Jakub Kiwior.
27' 1 - 1 Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) controls a cross from the corner kick and produces a great strike from the edge of the box that ricochets into the bottom right corner off the woodwork.
27' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

26' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Crystal Palace will have a chance to score from a corner.
23' Declan Rice (Arsenal) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
19' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) sends a cross into the box, but David Raya comes off his line to gather the ball.
15' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
13' Crystal Palace control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
10' Declan Rice (Arsenal) is in acres of space inside the box and lets fly with a shot which goes well wide of the left post. What a poor effort.
8' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) jumps for a header from the resulting set piece, but it goes way wide of the right post.
8' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) steps up to send the ball in.
7' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The ball is out of play and Crystal Palace manage to earn a corner.
6' The corner is swung in but Crystal Palace can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
6' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Crystal Palace, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

3' 1 - 0 Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal) outjumps the defence in the centre of the box and connects with the free kick from Martin Odegaard. He sends the ball inside the left post with his towering header and alters the score to 1:0.
2' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) was too forceful with his tackle and Michael Salisbury interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
Crystal Palace will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Michael Salisbury.
